ITEM 1 | Square-cut piece with golden-brown crust edges, bright red-orange tomato-like sauce layer across the top with slightly glossy, moist sheen, sitting on a white square plate; footprint roughly 5 cm by 5 cm (about 4% of plate area), thickness about 1 cm, flat and holding its shape | 45

ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-white soft solid piece, slightly glossy and smooth with a rounded tongue shape, lying on top of the red sauce layer near the center of the piece; footprint about 2.5 cm by 1 cm, about 0.5 cm thick, slightly soft and moist-looking | 8

ITEM 3 | Small scattered green herb sprigs, bright green thin leaves and fine stems, resting on top of the sauce near the pale piece; spread across about 2 cm by 2 cm, very light and thin | 1
